Dromaius 5 is a premium quality townhouse located in Jindabyne that offers a comfortable stay for up to eight people. With three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a spacious living area, this townhouse provides ample space for everyone. The bedrooms are well-appointed, with two queen-sized beds and a third room with two bunk beds, making it perfect for families or groups of friends. The townhouse also includes two private balconies with stunning views, as well as TVs in both queen rooms. The upstairs bathroom boasts a large corner spa, which is perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring the beautiful surroundings. The second bathroom offers a shower over bath, providing guests with all the amenities they need. The double lock-up garage with internal access and remote is perfect for storing bikes, boats, and skis and boards, making it ideal for year-round use. The townhouse also offers various amenities such as instantaneous hot water, WiFi, full laundry facilities, a coffee pod machine, a gas fireplace to keep guests warm during the winter and air conditions for the summer months. The spacious and fully equipped kitchen includes a microwave and dishwasher, making it easy to cook meals in the comfort of your own home. Enjoy the breathtaking views while grilling and dining on the expansive balcony with a covered entertainment area. Please be advised there may be some construction in progress in the surrounding areas due to ongoing development. Nevertheless, Dromaius 5 is a top-notch townhouse that guarantees a comfortable stay for families or friends looking to discover the stunning Jindabyne area. This property is 'Not Pet Friendly' STRA Permit ID: PID-STRA-42345

title: Ecocrackenback Chalet 12
description: Rates from AU$329 per night. Final price depends on dates, guests and availability. Welcome to Ecocrackenback — a collection of thoughtfully appointed alpine chalets nestled amongst the snow gums in the heart of Crackenback Valley. These premium eco chalets combine sustainable alpine design with upgraded interiors and additional comfort touches, creating a warm and inviting Snowy Mountains retreat. description: Rates from AU$369 per night. Final price depends on dates, guests and availability. Welcome to Eliza Lee 3! title: The Stone Cottage at Wollondibby
description: Rates from AU$323 per night. Final price depends on dates, guests and availability. Welcome to The Stone Cottage at Wollondibby, a unique and romantic alpine retreat where history, nature and modern comfort come together. Dating back to circa 1855, this beautifully renovated heritage-listed stone cottage has been lovingly restored using traditional building techniques while providing the comforts and conveniences of modern living. Nestled along the scenic Alpine Way, it offers couples the chance to step away from the everyday and enjoy a peaceful escape in the heart of the Snowy Mountains. Sleeping just two guests, the cottage is designed for cosy weekends and memorable stays. The open-plan interior features a comfortable queen-sized bed, a warm slow combustion fire and thoughtful touches throughout. Floor heating keeps the cottage cosy during the cooler months, while ceiling fans provide comfort in summer. The kitchenette has everything you need for a relaxed stay, including an induction hotplate, air fryer, convection microwave, pod coffee machine and dishwasher. Whether you're preparing breakfast before a day exploring the mountains or enjoying a quiet dinner together, everything is close at hand. Winter guests can make use of the drying cupboard to keep ski gear warm and ready for the next day's adventure, while the surrounding alpine region offers plenty of opportunities for skiing, snowboarding, hiking and exploring. In the warmer months, take advantage of the beautiful countryside surrounding Crackenback Valley. Spend your days exploring the Snowy Mountains, walking through the surrounding landscape or simply enjoying the peace and quiet of the property. One of the most special aspects of staying at The Stone Cottage is its history. Guests can take a walk back in time and explore historic sites on the property, including the foundations of the old Wollondibby Inn, the historic bathing area, private cemetery and the first woolshed in the area. These remnants offer a fascinating glimpse into the lives of the early settlers, including Mary and James McEvoy. There is intentionally no TV at The Stone Cottage. Instead, this is a place to slow down, curl up with a good book, enjoy the fire, share a bottle of wine and reconnect with the person you're travelling with. The property also incorporates a number of sustainability practices, including rainwater collection, recycling facilities, water-efficient taps and showers, towel reuse, insulated walls and ceilings, double-glazed windows and protected green spaces. Whether you're looking for a romantic weekend away, a peaceful mountain retreat or the chance to experience a little piece of Snowy Mountains history, The Stone Cottage at Wollondibby offers a truly special escape for two. description: Rates from AU$740 per night. Final price depends on dates, guests and availability. Welcome to Tukidale Cottage, a beautifully renovated farmhouse cottage nestled in the peaceful Thredbo Valley on Alpine Way.
